label: token right after an early z (original steps 2-4)
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase on the step right after a z was input, but only early in the sequence (t = 2-4; steps 0-1 never fire and t >= 5 hardly ever does). Precision is about 0.97 and this covers about 79% of activation mass. The strongest activations (about 1.0 of max) are at t = 3 in sequences like a z z X, u z z X, d z z X: the step after a second z. The z step itself at t = 2 gets about 0.35-0.45. The leftover recall is a long tail of weak activations (about 0.0-0.1 of max) at steps 2-5, mostly two steps after a z, along with diffuse weak firing elsewhere. Sequences whose first token is u/a/d/i/y show higher rates. It never fires in the copy phase, and almost never on the delimiter.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=3 & prev_tok=z (+8.15), orig0=a (+7.11), prev_tok=z (+6.93), t=2 & prev_tok=z (+6.69), prev2_tok=z (+6.49), orig0=u (+6.14). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-9.18), prev_tok=a (-7.00), t=8 (-6.87), prev2_tok=- (-6.59).
